current_state: Head a88e57b395fa13b61e6379aef8a3e96fe9bea1df, 5 files, +303/-82, bot-authored, fast-forward on master. WHAT CHANGED: metafilter/core.py gains _LOOKBACK_STEMS, _LOOKBACK_PATTERN, parse_lookback() and lookback_days(); the four hardcoded rolling blocks (precip 24h/48h/7d/30d, ssrd 30d, gdd 30d, swvl1 30d) are replaced by one generator driven by a lookback_columns argument that defaults to exactly the previous set. process_era5_data adds any window the active rules name. scripts/download_era5.py drops _LONG_LOOKBACK_PREFIXES for lookback_days_needed() and buffer_months(), which walks back until the requested span is covered. dry_streak_days has no window in its name and keeps its month of history explicitly. VERIFICATION: pytest -W error 168 passed (159 before, 9 new); precip_prev14d_mm computed end-to-end from a profile naming it, NaN through day 13 and 28.0 mm on day 14 for a 2 mm/day series; buffer_months(2024,3,30) returns Jan+Feb, (2024,8,30) returns Jul alone. COST: S1 1->2 land retrievals per month, S2-extended 2->3 in March only, legacy profile unchanged at 1, Open-Meteo unaffected. The S1 change is real: its 24h window reaches into the previous month, and without it day one of every month has no precip_prev24h_mm and can never satisfy the dry-canopy rule.
